description: (Needs Linux tools in this chat, and the user's switch Settings > Background mode > Phone commands) Run a command line on the phone itself, as Android's shell user (what `adb shell` gives): pm, am, settings, dumpsys, logcat -d, getprop, files under /sdcard. Returns its exit code and output (the last 20,000 characters). The user approves each command on a card first, unless they turned that off. This is not Buddy's Linux: your own shell is for files there. To use the screen, use the phone tools (tap, type_text, ...), not `input`. Never use it to get around an approval card, a BLOCKED answer or a step the user has to do themselves.
name: phone_shell
